description: The five continents with their number of countries and the starting price of each (the smallest data size for that continent alone) plus the whole world. Pass continent to list its countries (continent "world" lists every country); include_networks adds the operator names and a 5G flag per country. Use to show where the eSIM works.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

continent.description: Optional: list the countries of this continent (eu, as, am, af, oc) or of the whole world ("world").

include_networks.description: Optional: with continent, add the mobile networks (operator name + 5G flag) of each country.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country and continent names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

title: List coverage
